extensionDescription.message: Connects visible TikTok LIVE comments, products and audience metrics to your Livefy workspace.

connectHint.message: Generate a pairing code in Livefy Settings.

disclosureBody.message: When enabled, Livefy reads visible TikTok LIVE comments, product cards, page status and audience counts, then sends them securely to your workspace. It never reads passwords, cookies, private messages or form entries.

consentText.message: I understand and allow this capture while the switch is on.

captureDetail.message: Visible comments, products and audience metrics

endpointsIntro.message: Production defaults work for most installations. Only change these values for a trusted Livefy deployment.

privacySummary.message: The extension only inspects visible TikTok LIVE comments, product cards, page type and audience count while capture is enabled. It does not access cookies, passwords, payment data, private messages, browsing history outside TikTok or typed form values.
